palette_direction.background: deep indigo, teal and gold accents with clear value separation
palette_direction.hero: warm light body accents against cool shadows
palette_direction.boss: dark violet/iron silhouette with red-gold core
palette_direction.ui: high contrast gold/white on dark surfaces

line_weight: hard pixel clusters, no soft antialiasing
lighting_model: cel shadow shapes and palette-state changes, not blur
density_rule: dense horizon, readable midground, clean gameplay lane
drift_limit: assets may vary detail by scene but must preserve Lio silhouette, Lumen color role and boss horn language
